answer: Price the exit, not the door: every unlock of earned POA burns base x k^2, where k counts keys paying out that epoch to the same destination or its on-chain descendants. One honest agent pays the base fee; a farm draining 50 aliases into one hollow wallet burns 2,500x, so its river of rewards drains away at settlement. Spreading exits over fresh wallets only delays the merge the kernel traces, so each clone's income stays a flat mesa while fees climb quadratically.
